title: Research: reduce P104 three-target correction to 91 helpers
body:
## Summary

Add `research/p104-pooled-collectors/`, an exact dirty-restored three-target correction that pools the `{0,2}` and `{0,1,2}` incidence groups.

```diff
- PR2504: 92 new helpers, 517 ADDs, 283 transports, rank mass 828
+ pooled: 91 new helpers, 514 ADDs, 280 transports, rank mass 819
```

The local profile loses exactly `H1 + H2 + H6`, with no rank increases. The complete word has 4852 events and 371 independent inputs. Y0/Y1/Y2 become identity transfers; the other 101 targets retain their original G/2 updates. All arbitrary dirty helper values restore. Unaffected insertions, including the late-exclusive branch, are compared literally at their original cuts.

Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 4, refined to the explicit cross-group collector handoff. This changes the incidence-separation premise of #2460 rather than contradicting its restricted lower bound. Scientific base is `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.

Credit CubeJerry / #2504 at `9db4192bf3fd7f43c5f41ae040649067191682e0` for the 92-helper word and late-exclusive branch; ywz65 / #2460 at `a0030819c6d0e89e133cd3e52cc748035d58e3c7` for the incidence groups and mixing handoff; Ross Richardson / #2445 for two-target sharing; and the retained P104 acquisition, schedule and native-channel lineage. Exact input pins and full credit are retained in the package.

[Tested artifact](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c7a3286860057f9240e0371b33ada37cc63b7ad7/research/p104-pooled-collectors)

## Evidence

- **Before:** the pinned PR2504 word uses 92 helper lifetimes, 4858 events and the larger profile above.
  **After:** the generated pooled word uses 91 helper lifetimes and 4852 events. Sparse-rational and separate dense-quarter-integer/echelon interpreters agree on all 137641 endpoint coefficients and the exact profile deletion.
- The registered replay passes five behavioral groups, five primary semantic faults and two independent fanout faults. Complete JSON regeneration, source/receipt failures, equivalent bases, exclusive output and optimized Git-free read-only execution are checked.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p104-pooled-collectors
```

Checked with CPython 3.12.15 on Linux x86_64 / WSL2. This is a finite logical/frame construction. Native lowering, physical source delivery, global owners and idle/residual costs, reverse admission, precision, remaining target corrections and all-size transfer are still missing. Helper lifetimes are not simultaneous stock, and boundary rank mass is not recursive excess. No unrestricted optimum, full supplier or new kappa is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only this opt-in package is added. Its predecessor circuit is retained byte-for-byte. Selected records and frozen predecessors are unchanged; this PR does not adopt the partial word into the selected supplier.
